target.title: fix(agent-core): prevent parseKeyedAnswers from splitting URLs, Windows paths, and time strings
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The parseKeyedAnswers regex in src/agents/harness/user-input-bridge.ts eagerly splits any line containing : = or - at the first delimiter. This causes URLs (https://example.com), Windows paths (C:\Users\foo), and time strings (14:30) to be incorrectly split into fake keyed answers, corrupting the agent input.

Fixes #101722.

## Why This Change Was Made

The regex has no protection against common text patterns that contain colons but are not keyed answers:
- URLs: https:// gets split as key=https / value=//example.com
- Windows paths: C:\Users gets split as key=C / value=\Users  
- Time strings: 14:30 gets split as key=14 / value=30

The fix adds a negative lookahead after the delimiter to skip :// and :\ patterns, plus a post-match guard that skips entries where both key and value are purely numeric.

## User Impact

Users who include URLs, file paths, or time references in multi-question replies will no longer have their answers silently corrupted.

## Evidence

12 new unit tests + 6 existing Codex integration tests all passing, no regressions.

Closes #101722.
